notes.title: T-Pain x Trover Saves the Universe
FREE DLC OUT NOW
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34739370/e20e2b07dbae119f9985a8ce6c02c74ac6147042.jpg[/img]

Available now as a FREE UPDATE, Trover's Important Cosmic Jobs takes you into the boss’s offices where you’ll find other intergalactic employees who all need help keeping their jobs and staying alive (oof, unemployment is tough but murder?! What kind of place are they running?!) 

Get ready to unlock original skits, voiced by Justin Roiland, via virtual VHS tapes.The ICJ is full of quests, ultra adorable power babies, and the ever popular arcade game Space Slaaaaam!

[previewyoutube=Fz-Pz8bUU_M;full][/previewyoutube]

If you haven’t purchased the base game yet, Trover will be on sale for 15% off starting today through next Monday for fans worldwide via Steam and the Epic Games Store, and in North America only via the PlayStation Store.

Finally, to celebrate the launch, fans can also unlock an updated [url=https://www.snapchat.com/unlock/?metadata=01&type=SNAPCODE&uuid=2a92519af7244cd2a1fc70d7d64aa9ec]Trover Saves the Universe Snapchat Lens[/url]! Immerse yourself in a pool of power babies and stay tuned to see just where those little fellas are coming from.

If you run into any problems with Trover, please check out [url=https://www.troversavestheuniverse.com/support]our support page and our FAQ.[/url]

If you want a cool place to hang out and talk about all your favorite squanchy things… Join your fellow Squanchies in our [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/SquanchGames/]Reddit[/url] and/or [url=https://discord.gg/ya5aSR3]Discord.[/url]

notes.title: Having Fun with Jopo
notes.content:
Recently we asked people to [url=https://twitter.com/TroverGame/status/1161714226983047168]guess a character[/url] and oddly enough, no one guessed Jopo? Which is weird because this should of been super easy. He’s the main character of Jopo Saves the Universe!

             [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34739370/d58ba90a07a6b89af65d9f668d221caebbcd995d.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34739370/2bbae2457795a12533ce2f5e09dacaa96936323c.jpg[/img][/url]         [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34739370/f77f506d0a0643c9e7e5faa31b5c3fc04188936c.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34739370/a20e91302e49cc9e42103e63f714fe4988b44fc8.jpg[/img][/url]

Jopo came out just a little bit ago and we’ve been hype about the positive responses thus far. We’re very excited for you to see what we’ve been cookin up but in the mean time we think it might be a good time for another playthrough. I mean, if you don’t remember who Jopo is, how can you be prepared for the free content we’re workin’ on?

Make sure your game is up to date! Seriously… update that shit. [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ZKKakLVFK-tPpymJHjU-tj25jj9KPzjBfeGis5LB6Gg/edit#heading=h.uszklrdaffne]We rolled out a new update[/url]. 

Now go load up some Jopo Saves the Universe and refresh that brain noodle of yours. Also, hey, I think you might have missed a trophy/achievement Need ya back at 100%, buddy!

Don’t panic though, Jopo can help. 

Why are you still reading this? Go play Jopo!

notes.title: Justin Roiland's Trover Saves the Universe launches with the day's most disturbing trailer
notes.content:
Trover Saves the Universe, the new release from Squanch Games—that's the studio co-founded in 2016 by Rick and Morty co-creator Justin Roiland and former Gears of War executive producer Tanya Watson—is now available on Steam and the Epic Games Store. And it brings to us one of the weirdest, most pointless, disturbing, and longest-feeling launch trailers in memory, featuring Rich Fulcher as a deranged man in his underwear with large globs of sentient Play-Doh jammed into his eyes. 

First, however, a bit about the game itself: "Your dogs have been dognapped by a beaked lunatic named Glorkon who stuffed them into his eye holes and is using their life essence to destroy the universe. You're partnered with Trover, a little purple eye-hole monster who isn’t a huge fan of working or being put in the position of having to save the universe."   

I put a few minutes into Trover Saves the Universe to get a feeling for what it's like, and it seems very on-brand for Roiland and co.: Trover, your purple partner, is very much weird sci-fi Morty, while his boss (whose name escapes me) is obviously Rick. There's a lot of swearing, unless you select the "censored" option (which beeps out the f-bombs), and movement is restricted to teleport pads, reflecting the game's VR roots, although it's playable without VR hardware too.

The humor is very Rick and Morty-esque as well: At one point I killed an elderly Chairopian who was giving me attitude, which led to a throwaway crack about elder abuse and Trover fretting nervously about getting our stories straight and getting away before the cops showed up. Conversations are spluttering and filled with odd asides, occasional bits of stammering, and copious cursing. 

Trover Saves the Universe goes for $30/£24/€25 and it sounds like you can expect that price to hold for a good while: Squanch said that it's going to keep the game at full price "for longer than usual" so that it can release future DLC for free. I got a few light laughs out of what I played but it'll be up to someone else (maybe Chris, since it seems to be up his alley) to determine how it holds up over the duration.

Oh, and how about that trailer? Yeah, I got nothing. Sorry.

From the co-creator of Rick and Morty comes Trover Saves the Universe. Your pups are missing. The cosmos is at stake. Only you and Trover can save everything in this bizarre comedy adventure!

notes.title: Did you say DLC?
notes.content:
We sure did and no, we aren’t talking about dingle lickin’ cults…

We’re going to release new content FOR FREE by keeping Trover at full price for longer than usual, instead of lowering the game’s cost over time and charging for new content.

That means, once you’ve purchased the game, you’ll see lots of new Trover adventures coming your way until it doesn’t make sense to do that anymore. U COOL WIT DAT?
